ModMetadata.Name: Sprayer MkII
ModMetadata.Author: Snowy
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Sprayer MkII[/h1]
Makes painting pipes, cables, and chutes in Stationeers much faster and adds a two-can Spray Gun MkII.
[h2]Features[/h2] [list] [*][b]Whole-network painting:[/b] Using a Spray Gun paints the entire connected pipe, cable, or chute network at once (including inline tanks, while leaving standalone tanks and devices untouched). Hold Shift to paint a single segment instead. [*][b]Spray Gun MkII:[/b] Craftable in the Tier 2 Tool Manufactory. Holds two paint cans side by side to paint networks in a repeating stripe pattern (default: two primary, one secondary). The body can also be painted. [*][b]Bigger cans and fixed efficiency:[/b] Paint cans hold 5x more paint by default (100 sprays by hand). Fixes the vanilla Spray Gun efficiency bug and makes efficiency configurable (default 6x, giving 600 sprays per can). [*][b]Mod support:[/b] Works with modded networks built on LibConstruct, such as ReVolt cable trays. [*][b]Save safe:[/b] Safe to add to or remove from existing saves. [/list]
[h2]Configuration[/h2] All settings (can capacity, Spray Gun efficiency, single-segment modifier key, and stripe pattern) can be changed in-game through StationeersLaunchPad's mod config menu.
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [b]Notice:[/b] This is a BepInEx plugin mod and requires [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] (and BepInEx) to load. Subscribing on the Steam Workshop alone will not load this mod without StationeersLaunchPad installed.
